wf: township site map + satellite (Esri z17) at 44.43029,-78.27373: Hague Point between the Otonabee River (east) and the Lakefield Marsh wetland (west); the river-side rows along Beach Way are seasonal, and the transient serviced block (orange on the map, 171-227) lies on the marsh side behind a continuous wooded strip; the beach is a day-use area by the parking; default down; not waterfront

satellite (Esri z17/z18) at 49.7608,-92.8356: the RV loops sit at the north of the park; the southernmost pads look across an open lawn with scattered trees to the Wabigoon Lake shore ~50-70 m away, and the city boat basin on the east is beyond the park road (developed) - view, not frontage; lakeview

satellite (Esri z18) at 47.1450,-79.7536: trailer rows on the strip between the Ontario Northland railway and Lake Duncan's west shore; the shore-side rows look across the park's open common lawn with docks to the water ~25-45 m away (a used common area, and the drive-thru traveller rows are not identifiable); default down; lakeview

satellite (Esri z18) at 49.6472,-83.2843: the park's front row sits between its lane and Shallow Lake ~25-35 m from the water across open grass with campers' docks; the rows behind look over it; the park mixes seasonal contracts and transient lots and the shore row cannot be confirmed as traveller sites, so default down; lakeview

satellite (Esri z17) at 44.14717,-81.66554: dense rows inside a residential neighbourhood on the north side of Kincardine; the Lake Huron beach is ~300 m north-west beyond houses and streets (a walk to the beach, not frontage); not waterfront

operator site map + satellite (Esri z18) at 45.8909,-81.9192: the 22 numbered beachfront overnight sites line the east lane with their pads running straight onto the shared sand beach of Sheguiandah Bay (Georgian Bay), the water ~10-20 m beyond, no road or treeline between (cf. Meaford Memorial Park); bayfront

operator site map + satellite (Esri z17/z18) at 48.83882,-90.47162: the full-hookup (F1-F24) and water/electric (W12-W27) campsites are two inland rows in the middle of the point; the shore of Lac des Mille Lacs is held by a lane and a row of private trailers with docks, the cottages and marina by the south tip; default down; not waterfront

satellite (Esri z17) at 46.47070,-82.66184: rows and a dock basin on a bay of Dunlop Lake north-west of South Bay Road; the engine's only shore type is 'Waterfront No Service' (rigs to 20 ft, too short for a 23-ft trailer) and the serviced nightly sites cannot be placed at the water; default down; not waterfront
